facts.text: I am looking to find a screen protector for my new smartwatch.
I picked up an extra strap in black for $20.
I think I will go with the Zagg InvisibleShield for my smartwatch.
I heard good reviews about Zagg products.
I think the lifetime warranty sounds great.
I will follow the instructions carefully for the screen protector installation.
I am considering whether the screen protector will affect the touch sensitivity of my smartwatch.
I am considering getting a screen protector for my new iPhone 13 Pro.

I heard great things about Zagg products.
I think the lifetime warranty sounds amazing.

The wireless charging pad has been working great.
I might consider getting a case for my iPhone 13 Pro in the future.
